properties.name: World Cup
properties.description: World Cup is a long blue groomed ski run near the Kosciusko Express Chairlift.

properties.name: Dream Run
properties.description: Dream Run is a blue run from the bottom of the Cruiser area to the bottom of High Noon. The top half is steep, often with icy cover and moguls, whilst the second half is significantly narrower.

properties.name: The Glades
properties.description: The Glades is a series of ungroomed blue runs underneath the top of Gunbarrel Express. Often when the lower section is closed, skiers will exit to Valley View via Foxtrot

properties.name: Upper Village Trail, Supertrail
properties.description: Upper Village Trail is a long groomed green run that makes its way down the Crackenback area of Thredbo. Supertrail is a long blue groomed run through the Crackenback area of Thredbo. Conditions on the lower part are often slushy.

properties.name: Canonball
properties.description: Cannonball (Not to be confused with the MTB trail) is a long,  ungroomed black ski run that roughly follows the former Ramshead Chairlift line.

properties.name: Pegasus
properties.description: Pegasus is a short ungrommed blue run from Valley View onto the lower half of the Glades.

properties.name: Sasha's Schuss
properties.description: Sacha's Schuss is an off piste blue run above the basin area at Thredbo.

properties.name: Ballroom
properties.description: Ballroom is a popular groomed blue run in the centre of the Cruiser area. A small terrain park is sometimes set up on the bottom part of the run.

properties.name: Exhibition
properties.description: Exhibition is a long groomed blue run off the skier's left of Sponars T Bar.

properties.name: The Falls
properties.description: The Falls is an ungroomed blue run from the end of Eagle Way to the bottom of Sponars T Bar. It can involve some traversing, especially if coming from Snowgums Chairlift.

properties.name: Funnel Web Exit Run
properties.description: Funnel Web Exit Run is the main exit from Funnel Web and the Golf Course Bowl back to the main Crackenback area. Was known as Golf Course Exit Run until sometime between 2010 & 2015.

properties.name: Sundowner
properties.description: Sundowner is a long green/blue run that takes skiers from the Crackenback side of Thredbo to Friday Flat.

properties.name: High Noon
properties.description: High Noon is a long Blue groomed run mainly accessed from Gunbarrel Express. The Steeper and lower parts can form moguls during softer conditions.

properties.name: Ego Alley
properties.description: Ego Alley is a blue run off the skier's right of Sponars T Bar. The top half is largely ungroomed off piste, whilst the lower half where most Exhibition skiers join is typically groomed.

properties.name: Frank's Face, Upper Village Trail, Supertrail
properties.description: Frank's Face is an off piste blue run from the top of Karels to the bottom of Basin Tbar at Thredbo. The plateau in the middle is nearly always icy, with multiple steep lines bellow it, including Balls To The Wall., Upper Village Trail is a long groomed green run that makes its way down the Crackenback area of Thredbo. Supertrail is a long blue groomed run through the Crackenback area of Thredbo. Conditions on the lower part are often slushy.

properties.name: Basin Run
properties.description: Basin Run is the primary Green ski routes around the Basin T Bar. These are most often groomed.

properties.name: Albert's Amble
properties.description: Albert's Amble is a groomed blue ski run on the skier's right of Antons T Bar.

properties.name: Upper Village Trail
properties.description: Upper Village Trail is a long groomed green run that makes its way down the Crackenback area of Thredbo. Run split as most of the run has no snowmaking.

properties.name: Upper Village Trail
properties.description: Upper Village Trail is a long groomed green run that makes its way down the Crackenback area of Thredbo. Run split as the upper half has no snowmaking.

properties.name: The Bluff
properties.description: The Bluff is a steep, ungroomed black run that is accessed from the Kosciusko Express chairlift. Occasionally, a path may be groomed into the run from the Basin T bar.

properties.name: Little Beauty
properties.description: Little Beauty is a moderately steep black run. Like nearby True Blue, it is sometimes groomed yet can have moguls form at other times. A small creek crossing is present at the bottom that sometimes keeps the run closed in low snow.

properties.name: The Tunnel
properties.description: The Tunnel is a ungroomed, tree defined black run to the skier's left of Lenny's Leap.

properties.name: The Traverse
properties.description: The Traverse is a long groomed Traverse from the top of Gunbarrel Express chairlift to the Crackenback side of Thredbo.

properties.name: The Bluff
properties.description: The Bluff is a steep, ungroomed black run that is accessed from the Kosciusko Express chairlift. Occasionally, a path may be groomed into the run from the Basin T bar.

properties.name: The Schuss
properties.description: The Schuss is an ungroomed black run underneath the top half of the Meritts Gondola. It is rarely open due to the significant low-elevation snow required to open it.

properties.name: Old High Noon
properties.description: Old High Noon is the former path of the High Noon ski run. It is now overgrown and rarely skiable.

properties.name: Lower True Blue
properties.description: True Blue is a relatively steep blue run. Sometimes it is groomed, other times moguls can form on the run. Run split as ony the lower part of the run has snowmaking.

properties.name: Lenny's Leap
properties.description: Lenny's Leap is a groomed blue run on the skier's left of Antons T Bar.

properties.name: Giddy Up
properties.description: Giddy Up is the other main beginners run at Thredbo. It is accessed either from the Merrits Gondola Mid Station or from The Burrow Snow Runner.

properties.name: Racecourse
properties.description: Rossignol Race Course is a short Blue groomed run on the middle slopes near Snowgums Chairlift. It is often used for races. Listed as Black since June 2025.

properties.name: Eagle Way
properties.description: Eagle Way is a narrow catwalk from the top of the Kosciusko Express Chairlift. It is often crowded.

properties.name: Walkabout
properties.description: Walkabout is a popular wide green groomed run in the Cruiser area.

properties.name: Waimea
properties.description: Waimea is an steep, ungroomed face above the Cruiser area that is popular for powder skiing.

properties.name: True Blue
properties.description: True Blue is a relatively steep blue run. Sometimes it is groomed, other times moguls can form on the run. Run split as ony the lower part of the run has snowmaking.

properties.name: Section 44
properties.description: Section 44, known as Lower Funnel Web until June 2025, is an often ungroomed black run that continues on from Funnel Web. The second half of the run is narrow and fairly flat, which may require pushing. Due to it's low elevation, it is rarely open.

properties.name: Basin Run
properties.description: Basin Run is the primary Green ski routes around the Basin T Bar. These are most often groomed.

properties.name: Golf Course Exit Run
properties.description: Golf Course Exit Run is a narrow, ungroomed path out of the Golf Course Bowl that is defined mainly by a boundary rope. From it, skiers can take either Funnel Web Exit Run or Lower Funnel Web to return to the lifts.

properties.name: Supertrail
properties.description: Supertrail is a long, wide blue groomed run through the Crackenback area of Thredbo. Conditions on the lower part are often slushy. Snowmaking only exists beneath Black Sallees

properties.name: Gunbarrel Traverse
properties.description: Gunbarrel Traverse is a long groomed Traverse from the five-ways junction in the Cruiser area to the top of Gunbarrel Express, where it is slightly uphill.

properties.name: Valley View
properties.description: Valley View is a groomed blue run on the skier's far right of the Cruiser area. Additional unmarked runs exist in between Valley View and Ballroom that are also sometimes groomed.

properties.name: Supertrail, Lower Village Trail
properties.description: Supertrail is a long, wide blue groomed run through the Crackenback area of Thredbo. Conditions on the lower part are often slushy. Snowmaking only exists beneath Black Sallees, Lower Village Trail is a long groomed blue run down the Crackenback area of Thredbo.

properties.name: Trapdoor
properties.description: Trapdoor is a black traverse from the Basin Tbar over into Funnel Web.

properties.name: Bushranger
properties.description: Bushranger is a sereis of variously steep black gladed runs underneath the Snowgums Chairlift that eventually lead onto Cat Walk (part of Village Trail).

properties.name: Basin Run
properties.description: Basin Run is the primary Green ski routes around the Basin T Bar. These are most often groomed.

properties.name: Conrod Straight, Ego Alley
properties.description: Conrod Straight is a groomed blue run from the top of Sponars T Bar across towards the Crackenback area., Ego Alley is a blue run off the skier's right of Sponars T Bar. The top half is largely ungroomed off piste, whilst the lower half where most Exhibition skiers join is typically groomed.

properties.name: Bushranger
properties.description: Bushranger is a sereis of variously steep black gladed runs underneath the Snowgums Chairlift that eventually lead onto Cat Walk (part of Village Trail).

properties.name: Syd's Run
properties.description: Syd's Run is a short learning slope in Thredbo's Beginners Bowl, first named in June 2025. Current maps indicate it's on the North Side of the snow runner, but is decidedly on the South Side.

properties.name: Boundary Riders
properties.description: Boundary Riders is an ungroomed black run that goes down towards the creek before traversing out to the top of the Easy Rider T Bar. Occasionally cutting through the trees down towards Easy Rider T Bar is possible.

properties.name: Old High Noon Lower
properties.description: Old High Noon is the former path of the High Noon ski run. It is now overgrown and rarely skiable.

properties.name: Basin Run
properties.description: Basin Run is the primary Green ski routes around the Basin T Bar. These are most often groomed.

properties.name: Upper Giddy Up
properties.description: Giddy Up is the other main beginners run at Thredbo. It is accessed either from the Merrits Gondola Mid Station or from The Burrow Snow Runner.

properties.name: Squatters Run
properties.description: Squatters Run is a green groomed run that goes from the top of the Cruiser Express down to the Fiveways junction and then follows the line of the former duplex T-bars.

properties.name: Lovers Leap
properties.description: Sundance is an groomed blue run that is the alternative way to Valley Terminal. It is notable for crossing under the Alpine Coaster. Listed as Lovers Leap since June 2025.

properties.name: Foxtrot
properties.description: Foxtrot is a narrow, ungroomed blue traverse from The Glades to Valley View. It is unmarked on the trail map, only indicated with a ski patrol rope and an old sign.

properties.name: Sasha's Schuss
properties.description: Sacha's Schuss is an off piste blue run above the basin area at Thredbo.

properties.name: Michael's Mistake
properties.description: Micheal's Mistake is an ungrommed black run accessed from Antons T Bar. The popular entrance is via The Tunnel, with many rocks, bushes and short steeps scattered across the run.

properties.name: Little Beauty
properties.description: Little Beauty is a moderately steep black run. Like nearby True Blue, it is sometimes groomed yet can have moguls form at other times. A small creek crossing is present at the bottom that sometimes keeps the run closed in low snow.
This unnammed trail, shown as West Side in the 1980's, is a quieter alternative to Ballroom and Valley View

properties.name: Friday Flat
properties.description: Friday Flat is the main beginners run at Thredbo. As a result, it is often crowded and occasionally opened for night skiing (often for training only). It was known as Easy Does It prior to June 2025.
This unnammed trail, shown as West Side in the 1980's, is a quieter alternative to Ballroom and Valley View

properties.name: East High Noon
properties.description: East High Noon is a long Blue groomed run mainly accessed from Gunbarrel Express. The east side often has a RiderX course on the upper half. and is groomed less often on the lower half.

properties.name: Lower Village Trail
properties.description: Lower Village Trail is a long groomed blue run down the Crackenback area of Thredbo.

properties.name: Sundowner
properties.description: Sundowner is a long green/blue run that takes skiers from the Crackenback side of Thredbo to Friday Flat.

properties.name: Playground
properties.description: Playground is an groomed blue run on the skier's left side of the Cruiser area. A ridercross course is often set up on the run.

properties.name: High Noon to Friday Flat Beginner Entrance
The Traverse (To Cruiser)
properties.description: The Traverse (To Cruiser) is a green traverse that is the main way of accessing the Cruiser Area from Friday Flat.

properties.name: Vista
properties.description: Vista is a short blue run along Karels Tbar

properties.name: Funnel Web
properties.description: Funnel Web is a steep, usually ungroomed black run, accessed either from the top of Karels T bar via the Trapdoor chute entrance, or by traversing from the Basin via the Trapdoor run.

properties.name: Meadows
properties.description: Meadows is a blue groomed run on the middle slopes of the Crackenback area, in between World Cup and Supertrail.

properties.name: Bushranger
properties.description: Bushranger is a sereis of variously steep black gladed runs underneath the Snowgums Chairlift that eventually lead onto Cat Walk (part of Village Trail).

properties.name: Conrod Straight
properties.description: Conrod Straight is a groomed blue run from the top of Sponars T Bar across towards the Crackenback area.

properties.name: Kareela Cross
properties.description: Kareela Cross is a black (formerly blue) run that traverses from the bottom of Basin T-bar to World Cup.

properties.name: Basin Run
properties.description: Basin Run is the primary Green ski routes around the Basin T Bar. These are most often groomed.

properties.name: Cruiser Traverse
properties.description: Cruiser Traverse is a long blue Traverse from the top of Antons T Bar to the Cruiser area. It is often groomed from the top of Sponars T Bar and popular hike to terrain exists on the skier's left of the run.

properties.name: Bunny Walk
properties.description: Bunny Walk is a relatively flat green traverse beneath the more popular Catwalk (Part of Village Trail). Is is rarely open, likely due to a creek crossing at the stop. Listed as black since June 2025, due to the various tree-lined steep entrances.

properties.name: Frank's Face
properties.description: Frank's Face is an off piste blue run from the top of Karels to the bottom of Basin Tbar at Thredbo. The plateau in the middle is nearly always icy, with multiple steep lines bellow it, including Balls To The Wall.

properties.name: The Bowl
properties.description: The Bowl (locally known as "Powder Bowl") is an ungroomed black run directly underneath the Cruiser Express chairlift. A large dip is often present halfway down.
